items.quote: So the man of God returned with him and ate and drank in his house.
items.contrast: The man of God was the person to be brought back; the old prophet was the person claiming he had been told to bring him.
items.reason: The closing sentence resolves the pronouns: the man of God returned with the old prophet and ate at his house. This supports the key and requires distinguishing the recipient of the invitation from the person who issued it.
